description: List the AI image, video, music, and sound-effect models available on BudgetPixel with standard credit prices and capabilities. Featured models come first with a one-line role hint (when to pick each). Image models that charge by output size list every size's price (the size you pass as resolution sets the price). Video models are priced per SECOND by resolution; music models are flat per track; sound effects are per second with a 3-second minimum. Prices shown are standard rates in credits. Video resolutions delivered as H.265 (HEVC) instead of H.264 are marked, because some browsers cannot play H.265.
name: list_models
title: List Models
